description.value: Jack's Place is a casual pub and patio restaurant at Bear Mountain in Langford, BC, serving an unusually eclectic menu that spans North American comfort food, wood-fired pizza, and a full in-house sushi bar operating as Kuma Sushi. The venue bills itself as 'Bear Mountain's Lunch & Dinner Patio Hangout,' with a broad range of dishes from tacos and poke bowls to sushi rolls and craft cocktails. Its location in the Bear Mountain resort community puts it within reach of cyclists exploring the hills west of Victoria.

address.value: 2020 Country Club Way, Langford, BC V9B 6R3

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and confirms an active full-service pub and sushi/pizza restaurant at Bear Mountain in Langford. Phone, address, and URL all cross-check between OSM and the website contact page (minor formatting differences only). No bike-specific infrastructure—racks, parking, or patio bike visibility—is mentioned anywhere in the website or OSM tags, leaving bike parking and water refill as null; takeout is confirmed via 'order now' prompts on multiple pages, and vegetarian/GF items are evidenced by a tofu power bowl option and a gluten-free beer listing.
concerns: OSM cuisine tag is 'american' but the menu also includes a full sushi bar (Kuma Sushi) and pizza kitchen—OSM tag understates the offering.
Contact page identifies the venue as 'JACKS PLACE & KUMA SUSHI', a slightly different name than the OSM record 'Jack's Place'; likely the same business operating two concepts under one roof.
No bike infrastructure mentioned anywhere on website or in OSM tags; required criteria cannot be confirmed without a site visit.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Jack's Place is a legitimate, active pub/restaurant that could serve touring cyclists, but none of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) are confirmed from textual evidence on the website. On-site verification or direct contact is needed before listing.
